title: Construct Validation in Social and Personality Research: Current Practice and Recommendations
authors: Jessica K. Flake and Jolynn Pek and Eric Hehman
verification_basis: Publisher DOI record or formal scholarly proceedings/journal record; metadata cross-checked against the manuscript bibliography during the staged reference audit.

manuscript_occurrences.claim: find incomplete reporting of structural-validity evidence and frequent reliance on coefficient alpha alone

primary_support_scope.passages: Printed pages 372 and 374: Method/Coding of Articles; Discussion/On the Fly Measurement
